name: PO Price Check
script:
# Initialize the custom field to 0 doc.custom_needs_expense_approval = 0 details = [] for item in doc.items: # Fetch the last purchase rate from the Item master (default to 0 if none exists) last_rate = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item.item_code, "last_purchase_rate") or 0.0 # If the current rate is higher, flag the custom field if item.rate > last_rate: doc.custom_needs_expense_approval = 1 details.append(f"Item: {item.item_code} ({item.item_name})
" f"Last Rate: {last_rate}
" f"New Rate: {item.rate}
") # If approval is needed, format the details for the custom text field if doc.custom_needs_expense_approval: doc.custom_price_increase_details = "

".join(details) else: doc.custom_price_increase_details = ""
